Visible on this screenshot only:

- **Coach numeric guidance:** “Example 90° stub-up on 3/4 EMT, rise 12 in:” plus “Mark take-up ≈ 6 5/16 in (assistive)” and bend steps.
- **Assistive disclaimer:** “Assistive guidance only — not a substitute for code or engineer judgment.”
- **Unit cue:** “Imperial” control and inch (“in”) quantities in the guidance.

**Fail criteria not met:** This is chat chrome, not calculator-only; “QuickBend” branding is not visible.

**Cannot judge from this image alone:** Whether the bubble is a true user/coach turn pair vs a single demo block; whether live AI is configured (text says “Demo bend pack (AI not configured)”); any behavior outside this frame.
